name: music-video
description: Make a beat-synced kinetic-typography music video about any company: researched topics, lyrics and a Suno prompt, then a 4K video with its own look, drawn as an HTML page and rendered with Playwright and ffmpeg. Optional extras: a full-length vertical 9:16 version for Reels and TikTok, stand-alone shorts cut from it, and cover posters.
